name: agents-panel
description: Sidebar listing each subagent with model, context fill, estimated cost and time, drawn as pixel chameleons that change colour as their context fills and grow as they use tokens

launch.title: Open the Agents panel
launch.description: auto: use what you picked in the first-run question or with /agents-panel (when a subagent starts, if nothing yet). always: at the start of every session. subagent: when the first subagent starts. ask: ask every session. off: only with /agents-panel

prices.title: Custom model prices
prices.description: model=input/output in US$ per million tokens, comma-separated, with an optional @size for the context window. Example: gpt-5=1.25/10, gemini-2.5-pro=1.25/10@1m, opus=3/15. For models the panel can't price (such as GPT or Gemini through a gateway), or to replace a Claude list price with your own rate.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter code to show costs in, such as MYR, SGD, EUR or JPY. The rate is fetched once a day from the European Central Bank's reference rates (frankfurter.dev); only the currency code is sent. USD makes no request.

exchangeRate.title: Fallback exchange rate
exchangeRate.description: Units of your currency per 1 US dollar, such as 4.07 for MYR. Used only when the daily rate can't be fetched, or for a currency the ECB doesn't publish. Leave empty to fall back to US dollars.
